thesis: A scheduled macro release that deviates from consensus can create a short-lived, mechanically explainable cross-asset reaction.
trigger: Scheduled release with a pre-written directional map and a material consensus deviation.
entry_rule: Trade only the pre-mapped reaction after the authoritative release is public.
exit_rule: Price invalidation, reversal of the mapped mechanism, target, or 24-hour time stop.
sizing_hints: One driver budget across all instruments expressing the same event.
